title: On Enhancing the value of the whole estate
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：enhance　|　正文 363 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 enhance 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the builder ① enhanced the value of the whole estate year after year, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② enhances the value of the whole estate for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ enhance the value of the whole estate at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ enhanced the value of the whole estate before — a line in the plan for October 1986 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Enhancing the value of the whole estate year after year, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ enhance the good name of the family for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Enhance the good name of the family at once and never mention it again.

By 1999 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ enhances the good name of the family year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ enhanced the value of the whole estate again when nobody else would.

⑩ To enhance the value of the whole estate, my mother said in 2004, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody enhances the value of the whole estate for the whole place again and somebody must enhance the value of the whole estate year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 提高（一般过去式 enhanced the value of the whole estate：1992 年施工员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 提高（一般现在 enhances the value of the whole estate：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 提高（不定式 to enhance the value of the whole estate：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 提高（过去完成时 had enhanced the value of the whole estate：1986 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 提高（动名词 enhancing the value of the whole estate 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 增进（enhance the good name of the family：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去增进让这家人的名声更好）
G. v. 增进（enhance the good name of the family：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 提高（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 enhances the good name of the family，而母亲又一次 enhanced the value of the whole estate）

answers.why: enhance 意为“提高”，1992 年施工员年年地提高提高了整处田产的价值，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 enhanced。
enhance 意为“提高”，自那以后施工员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 enhances。
enhance 意为“提高”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯提高提高了整处田产的价值”，此处为不定式 to enhance the value of the whole estate。
enhance 意为“提高”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1999 年之前就有人提高过，故用过去完成时 had enhanced。
enhance 意为“提高”，施工员说“提高提高了整处田产的价值这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 enhancing the value of the whole estate 作主语。
enhance 意为“增进”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去增进让这家人的名声更好”，should ever 之后用原形 enhance the good name of the family。
enhance 意为“增进”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻增进让这家人的名声更好（enhance the good name of the family at once），以后再也不要提起。
enhance 意为“提高”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例增进让这家人的名声更好，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 enhances。
enhance 意为“提高”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地提高提高了整处田产的价值，用一般过去式 enhanced 叙述。
enhance 意为“提高”，结尾那句是母亲 2004 年的话：要提高提高了整处田产的价值，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 enhance 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the builder enhanced the value of the whole estate year after year, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder enhances the value of the whole estate for the whole place whenever the site asks.
Enhancing the value of the whole estate year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever enhance the good name of the family for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site enhances the good name of the family year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother enhanced the value of the whole estate again, and the site remembered that half.
